post.summary: Mint a 15-minute reusable read-only task embed ticket.
post.description: **actor.task.view_ticket** (public): Mint a 15-minute reusable read-only task embed ticket. Only the person's own Bearer token and their own task are accepted; session cookies, service and delegated tokens cannot mint. Another person's task returns 404. Tickets work only on /embed/task/:id and its events/still reads, never on a write route. Wrong-task or expired tickets return 403. Stored only as SHA-256 hashes, bound to task and requester.

schema.title: ActorTaskViewTicket
schema.description: actor.task-view-ticket@1: a reusable read-only view of one task for its owner, valid for 15 minutes. The URL contains a bearer credential; never log it or forward it in a referrer.
